name: comp-547
blurb: Vertical list of uploaded images with file info and remove buttons.
description: Multi-image upload in list format, showing thumbnails, file names, and size. Each item has individual remove control.
use_when: Document uploads, file browser style interfaces, or detail-focused image lists.
avoid_when: High-volume uploads where grid layout is more compact.
a11y: Each list item is accessible. Remove buttons clearly labeled with file names.
